pages.text: The Generator Matrix: matrix casings enclose a sealed space (low tier 3×3×3 / high tier 5×5×5), with the controller and ports on the walls.$(li)Low tier: 45× burn speed, 1.5× single-unit output$(li)High tier: 200× burn speed, 3× single-unit output$(br2)Piece generators together into an array and your output climbs in leaps and bounds.

The Purifier Matrix: a 3×3×3 sealed space, 30× purifying speed, 150 energy per tick.$(br2)$(2,4)Life Conversion Matrix$(0): a 3×3×3 sealed space that converts energy into life energy at 45×. Want to cross over into life tech? Flip open the "Book of Life".
